test_unsupported_file_formats_raise_erro: test that unsupported file formats like RIEGELI and TFRECORD raise NotImplementedError when creating ArrayRecordDataSource
test_missing_split_raises_error: test that requesting a non-existent split raises ValueError with Unknown split message
test_data_source_calls_array_record_data: test that ArrayRecordDataSource deserializes examples using deserialize_example_np with correct decoders argument
test_data_source_is_iterable: test that ArrayRecordDataSource supports iteration and indexing with sequential integer indices starting from zero
test_data_source_is_sliceable: test that tfds.data_source with split ranges like train[:50%] correctly computes skip and take file instructions
